title: Padres sweep Cubs; NLDS Game 1 vs. Brewers is Saturday on FS1
dek: San Diego beat Chicago 4-1 to sweep the Wild Card Series. Game 1 against Milwaukee is Saturday at 5:30 p.m. Pacific on FS1.
keyPoints: Game 2 final: Padres 4, Cubs 1, at Petco Park.
Gavin Sheets hit a pinch-hit, two-run home run in the fifth inning.
NLDS Game 1: Saturday, October 3, at 5:30 p.m. PT on FS1, FOX Deportes and FOX One.
The Brewers had the best record in baseball this season.

sources.title: Padres get revenge with commanding sweep of Cubs in Wild Card Series

body: The Padres needed only two games. San Diego beat the Cubs 4-1 on Wednesday night at Petco Park to sweep the National League Wild Card Series, holding Chicago to one run across 18 innings.

The big swing came in the fifth inning, when Gavin Sheets came off the bench and hit a two-run home run on a 100.8 mph fastball. Xander Bogaerts drove in a run with a single in the second, and Ethan Salas added a sacrifice fly, which MLB.com noted made him the youngest player ever to record a postseason sacrifice fly. Manager Craig Stammen summed up the work ahead: "We had 13 bricks to lay. Two down, 11 more to go."

Next up is the Milwaukee Brewers, who finished with the best record in baseball. Game 1 of the National League Division Series is Saturday, October 3, at 8:30 p.m. Eastern, which is 5:30 p.m. Pacific. It airs on FS1, with FOX Deportes and FOX One also carrying it. MLB.com lists Jacob Misiorowski, seen by many as the likely NL Cy Young Award winner, as Milwaukee's starter.
The Division Series is a best-of-five, so the schedule will move quickly once it starts. Teams post updated times on their official sites as each game is set.
If you are planning to watch Saturday, check that your TV provider or streaming service includes FS1 before the weekend, so you are not searching for a login at first pitch.
